lines.en: I have a history of chasing my tail but a track record clean of having ever caught it.

What this means is that when something larger and scarier than me does appear and ultimately scoop me up with its endless, half-transparent arms that I will not yet be accustomed to how it feels to be held.
There are many things in life I do not understand.
Like dust particles. Or the romanticization of death. Or even myself at times as this jar I’m trapped inside reflects not the me that I see but the one that you do.
Yet, what sleeps inside it is a mystery to all of us.
When I was younger and the ring still fit my ankle, I worried not of what it meant to die but simply that of dying.
But as my bones expanded, my worries flipped and now I think the opposite.
At this stage in my life, it is not the act of dying that keeps me up at night, but the fear of what comes after.
My hands grace the glass of my infinite jar, staring back at someone I can only view as the protagonist of this story while the only thing that truly matters is the glass itself.
If that shatters, what comes next?
How will the creature (Me) inside of it (The jar) appear to the untrained eye when filled with shards of my former home and other assorted shrapnel and foreign objects?
For even if my breathing were to continue after such a tragic event, I’d not be seen as who I am but who I was.
There is no moral to this untimely, rhetorical passing- but I don’t think there needs to be.
So long as you can imagine what it feels like walking mile after mile in these shoes filled with tacks, my words will have worked.
So long as you can relate, it will have all been worth it.
That’s likely what I’d think as the light drains from my eyes.
I lied about the lying. Things have been looking up.
Feelings are good and I am supposed to have them.

There’s nothing I need to fix because the world will fix it for me. All I have to do is live my life and smile and forget but also accept the things I forgot and couldn’t accept but that’s hard when my brain is a brain and-
Slow down.
Deep breaths.
Expel your worries from the depths of your lungs.
You are you.
I am me.
And neither one of us knows which is which and when.
Warble, warble, warble.
My phone goes off roughly thirteen feet from the next streetlight.
I make sure to stand beneath it when I answer.
: Hel-
: SENSEI!!!!!!!
: Ami?...What’s wrong?
: Everything! Everything is wrong!
: Slow down. Start from the-
: I don’t know where I am!
: How can you not know where you are? You weren’t kidnapped, were you?
: No, you idiot! I came here myself! But I don’t know how to get back and I’m too scared to move!
: Have you tried your GPS-
: Of course! Stop thinking I’m such an idiot! It’s just not working and it won’t tell me where I am and I need you to come get me!
: But how am I supposed to do that if you don’t know where you are? Kumon-mi is huge. I need a hint or...something at the very least.
: I think this is...the old district?
: No, I’m sure it is. That’s where I am. But I don’t know how to leave and I’m too scared to even walk right now. My legs are shaking so much. Can you please come help me? Please?
: What are you even doing all the way over there?
: I don’t know! I was just doing what I was told!
: By who? Who would ask you to go all the way over there and why would you listen to them in the-
: ARE YOU COMING OR NOT?!
Her voice sounds different than normal, and not just because it’s panicked.
It’s like her mouth was stuffed with worms and all of the worms are screaming at the same time but when they open their worm-mouths more worms come out and basically it just sounds like worms.
This is a job for the worm-man.
: Yeah, I’ll head over now. Just try and figure out where you are in the meantime, okay?
I’m glad my worms still come out normal despite being the word-man.
Wait, no. I got that backwards.
Hold on. I will fix.
The only way to bring life back to normal is with a bus ride backwards.
It’s a poem again, but a lack of rhyming words has forced in blackbirds.
But birds are all I talk about, so let’s try discussing...placards?
No! That’s not exciting either! Here! Just take the fucking password!
: Do you believe in God?
: Of course. How else would we have gotten here?
: How do you think He feels when we defy Him?
: Technically speaking, God would likely be genderless. God is an entity who exists on a plane so far detached from human life that merely comparing It to us is disrespectful.
: But weren’t we all created in His image?
: Its image. And I think not.
: I think God is so wonderful that looking at It would blind us. It is so bright and so powerful that we can not even comprehend It.
: Is Mom with God now?
She is.
: Jeez, you’re really going through it tonight, aren’t you?
: Any reason why? Something I can help with?
: Why what?
: Why do I keep seeing you?
: Because you’re lucky.
: Not everybody gets regular chances to spend time with their dead girlfriend, you know. You should be savoring moments like these.
: How could I?!
: Oh my. You never raise your voice — especially at me. You must feel pretty strongly about this.
: Here, maybe this will cheer you up! You still like costumes, don’t you? There’s no way such a cute-
: Actually, wait. Isn’t this costume kinda...half-assed?
: Whatever! Screw it! Come at me with all you’ve got, big guy!
: Leave...
: Please...
: Meow?
: I don’t...want to see you anymore...
: Hissssssssssssss...
: Hah...fine. I’ll go back to my never-ending pool of darkness. Left to float there forever and ever and ever and ever, totally unfulfilled.
: I always knew Heaven was a joke, but it would have been really cool if there was at least something after death.
: Here’s the thing though, Aki-kun. You can’t just ignore me forever. Especially now that you’re literally seeing me.
: Does this really look like moving on to you? All you’re doing is making things harder for yourself.
: Well, what else am I supposed to do?!
: How should I know? I’m a cat. Meow.
: Whatever it is, though, you’re not going to find it here.
: Then where?...
: Where will I find it?...
: I think you already know that.
: You found me...
: And I didn’t even give you any hints...
: Ami...what are you doing out here? It’s the middle of the night and we’re miles away from home. You know this place isn’t safe.
: I didn’t come here on my own, though! This wasn’t my idea!
: Then whose idea was it?
: Maya and Ayane’s!
: ...What?
: They asked me to hang out tonight and told me to meet up with them here...but when I showed up, there was no one there.
: So I called them and they didn’t answer....
: And when I looked at my GPS it wouldn’t work...
: And I forgot where I was and couldn’t find my way back, so I got even more lost! And then people were staring at me, so I got scared! And I still don’t know where they are and-
: And why did they do this to me?! Weren’t they supposed to be my friends?!
: I’m sure it’s just some sort of misunderstanding.
: It’s not! I tried to tell you the other day, but they’ve been all kinds of mean to me lately!
: They’re bullying me! Leaving me out of things I’d always be included in! And neither of them is telling me why! So why?! Why are they doing this?!
: Ami-
: I just want my friends back!!!!!!!!! Waaaahhhhhhhhahahahh!!!!!!!
: Give me a minute. I’ll call them and see what’s going on. I’m sure it’s-
: What’s wrong?...
: My phone’s dead.
: Really?...
: It was fine when I left Kaori’s apartment. I don’t get how-
: What were you doing at Kaori’s apartment?
: Does that really matter right now?
: Were you having sex with her?
: What?
: Do you and Kaori have sex together? Are you going to leave me for her?
: I don’t see how that’s relevant at all, but no. We don’t. And I’d appreciate it if you wouldn’t ask me questions like that anymore.
: Is that why you won’t have sex with me? Because you’re too busy having sex with Kaori?
: Did you know she used to post pictures of herself on the Internet? I bet she’s had sex with lots of people. You shouldn’t do that kind of thing with her. It’s not safe.
: Kaori’s an...interesting character. But if you think that’s the type of person she is, you’re way off.
: Did she tell you that? Is that how she got you to have sex with her?
: Ami, I’ve never done anything like that with Kaori. And I’d appreciate it if you wouldn’t ask me questions like that anymore.
: I only ask things like that because I love you.
: Well, please love me in a less intrusive way.
: Do you think I’m a burden, Sensei?
: Do you think Maya and Ayane are leaving me behind because I’m slowing them down? Or keeping them from doing the things they like?
: You’re not going to do that too...are you? You’re not going to leave me?
: I’m not going to leave you. You’re a part of me.
: Your organs are a part of you. And if one of them stops doing its job, it can kill you.
: So you can either get a new organ to replace the failing one or, in some cases, have it removed altogether.
: Is that what I am to you? An organ you can just give up? A body part you can just cut off?
: No...you’re not like that at all.
: So you’re saying you can’t live without me?
: If that’s what makes you happy, sure.
: Say it.
: Say you can’t live without me.
: I can’t live without you.
: Really?...
: Of course...
: I can’t live without you either.
: Yeah...I can see that.
: I, umm...I know you don’t like when I ask things like this, but...can you maybe...give me a piggyback ride home? I’m not sure how well my legs will work right now.
: You really can’t walk on your own?
: I probably can, just...it’ll be really slow and I don’t want to annoy you. Plus, having a shoulder to dry my tears on would be a really big help.
: Then...fine. But only because you look pathetic right now and I feel kind of bad for you.
: I’ll take what I can get...
: Thank you, Sensei...I know you hate doing stuff like this.
: I hope I’m not too heavy.
Ami rests atop my shoulders and, just as the tongue of the accused did mere hours (or less) ago, steals away the unrest that I’ve been feeling.
It’s as if her body is a dam — and all of the worries in all of the world have once again been liquefied only to get caught up behind this brand new barrier.
I wonder if that’s why we’re in here.
Maybe it doesn’t have anything to do with the war at all.
Maybe the walls of Kumon-mi are our dam, and the world outside of them is simply too full of horrible things to warrant letting any of them in.
While this thought softens the beat of my heart, I know it’s not a good thought to have. And I know it can’t be true.
Things aren’t always exactly as they seem. I’ve lost track of how many times I’ve had to tell you that.
But there are certain things I can’t help but feel like are exactly as they seem.
The walls.
The sky. The moon. The earth.
But more importantly than all of that-
How much I love my niece.
Just look at her.
Isn’t she the cutest?
Isn’t she the cutest?
Isn’t she the cutest?
She is.
: Heheh...
: This reminds me a lot of when I was younger...
: Did you ride on my shoulders a lot like this back then?
: Not really.
: My dad would hold me like this when we were going on walks in the park, but that’s not really something I ever got to experience with you.
: It would have been nice if I did. But that would also mean my parents would have been taken away earlier than they were and...
: And...
: B-But that didn’t mean I never fantasized about it! I always looked forward to seeing you when you came over! And I still think about, like...riding on your shoulders and stuff now.
: We just never had a chance to when we were finally put together.
: But you’d still hold me tight sometimes...
: And I’d fall asleep in your arms...
: But then it was right back to normal.
: But normal was never normal.
: And it isn’t normal today either.
: I tried to change things sometimes.
: I thought I knew what you wanted.
: But I was a stupid little girl.
: I didn’t understand what you wanted at all.
: But now I do.
: Now, I know that all you really want is to feel safe.
: So I built a world where you could.
: I made our house into a home. I filled it to the brim with your favorite foods and activities. And all I’ve ever asked for in exchange for all of that is your attention.
: And I know it might seem like I ask for a little too much attention sometimes. And I’m sorry for that.
: I’m a very needy girl.
: And that’s why I’m so scared now. Because, sometimes...it feels like you’re trying to run away.
: How come?
: Did what you want change?
: Do I not understand you as much as I used to?
: If there’s something I’m missing, tell me.
: I’d do anything for you, Sensei.
: And I mean anything.
: You do more than enough, Ami.
: But for now, I want to go home and sleep. So just stay put and try not to move around too much. It makes walking hard.
: Okay...I’m tired too.
: Besides, who needs friends anyway? All I’ve ever really needed is you.
: And I’m sure you feel the same about me. Don’t you, Sensei?
: Yeah, sure. Whatever.
: Say it with a little more sincerity, please. Repeat after me, “Ami is the ultimate niece-“
: Ami is the ultimate niece...
: “And the only one I’ll ever love.”
: And...the only one I’ll ever love.
: Heh...
: Heheheh...
: Hahah! Hahahahahaha! Hahaha!
: What are you cracking up about up there?
: Hahahahahah!
: It’s just...hahahahahahah! It's just so crazy how much I love you!
: How are you not laughing?! I’m so obsessed it’s kind of hilarious!
: Yeah, well...
: It’s a little less funny when you’re the one being obsessed over...
: Heheh...heh...
: I don’t know about that, Sensei...
